storyline.real: Leclerc leads after Bottas stops for fresh intermediates and tries to run to the flag without stopping; Bottas retakes the lead on lap 47, Leclerc pits and finishes fourth.
storyline.headline: Leclerc turns a lost lead into an Istanbul podium

mastery.label: Make exactly one stop for fresh intermediates

hidden.label: Push for no more than 9 laps

eras.briefing: Istanbul, 2021. Light rain all afternoon, and a track that never dries enough for slicks. Bottas starts from pole, Leclerc third. When the leaders stop for fresh intermediates, Leclerc stays out and leads.
